name: Alphabet
tagline: Search, YouTube and Google Cloud at a discount to its own highs.
thesis: About 30% below its May record close
Several businesses that each lead their market
moat: Scale and data network effects in search and video, plus a cost advantage from its own chips.
outlook: The market prices in a lot of AI disruption to search. If search revenue holds up and Cloud keeps growing, the shares look cheap versus peers.
news: Closed at $280.20 on Nov 17, around 30% below its May 13 record.
risks: Search share loss to AI assistants
changeMind: Search revenue declining for two straight quarters would drop it to Hold
